A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (4 April 2024). Its words are Decipher's errata from the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-limitedresources-PC-2024-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Limited Resources (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): Same words as the E card. The whole card is drawn again at a larger size, with the mark “D-E1” in place of “E”.

The whole E card image and the whole D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
